verses.original: אַל־ תִּשְׂמַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀ אֶל־ גִּיל֙ כָּֽעַמִּ֔ים כִּ֥י זָנִ֖יתָ מֵעַ֣ל אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אָהַ֣בְתָּ אֶתְנָ֔ן עַ֖ל כָּל־ גָּרְנ֥וֹת דָּגָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·maḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’el- gîl kā·‘am·mîm kî zā·nî·ṯā mê·‘al ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ā·haḇ·tā ’eṯ·nān ‘al kāl- gā·rə·nō·wṯ dā·ḡān
verses.literal: Do not rejoice O Israel with exultation like the nations for you have played the harlot against your God you have made love [for] hire on every threshing floor . . .

verses.original: גֹּ֥רֶן וָיֶ֖קֶב לֹ֣א יִרְעֵ֑ם וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְכַ֥חֶשׁ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: gō·ren wā·ye·qeḇ lō yir·‘êm wə·ṯî·rō·wōš yə·ḵa·ḥeš bāh
verses.literal: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them and the new wine will fail them

verses.original: לֹ֥א יֵשְׁב֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוָ֑ה אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְשָׁ֤ב מִצְרַ֔יִם יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ טָמֵ֥א וּבְאַשּׁ֖וּר
verses.transliteration: lō yê·šə·ḇū bə·’e·reṣ Yah·weh ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·šāḇ miṣ·ra·yim yō·ḵê·lū ṭā·mê ū·ḇə·’aš·šūr
verses.literal: They will not remain in the land of the LORD Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria

verses.original: לֹא־ יִסְּכ֨וּ יַיִן֮ לַיהוָ֥ה׀ זִבְחֵיהֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יֶֽעֶרְבוּ־ לוֹ֒ לָהֶ֔ם כְּלֶ֤חֶם אוֹנִים֙ כָּל־ אֹכְלָ֖יו יִטַמָּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־ לַחְמָ֣ם לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yis·sə·ḵū ya·yin Yah·weh ziḇ·ḥê·hem wə·lō ye·‘er·ḇū- lōw lā·hem kə·le·ḥem ’ō·w·nîm kāl- ’ō·ḵə·lāw yi·ṭam·må̄·ʾū kî- laḥ·mām lə·nap̄·šām lō yā·ḇō·w bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will not pour out wine [offerings] to the LORD and their sacrifices will not please Him [but will be] to them like the bread of mourners all who eat will be defiled For their bread [will be] for themselves it will not enter the house of the LORD

verses.original: מַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ מוֹעֵ֑ד לְי֣וֹם וּלְי֖וֹם יְהוָֽה׃ חַג־
verses.transliteration: mah- ta·‘ă·śū mō·w·‘êḏ lə·yō·wm ū·lə·yō·wm Yah·weh ḥaḡ-
verses.literal: What will you do on the appointed day on the day of the LORD’s feast

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה הָֽלְכוּ֙ מִשֹּׁ֔ד מִצְרַ֥יִם תְּקַבְּצֵ֖ם מֹ֣ף תְּקַבְּרֵ֑ם מַחְמַ֣ד לְכַסְפָּ֗ם יִֽירָשֵׁ֔ם קִמּוֹשׂ֙ ח֖וֹחַ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh hā·lə·ḵū miš·šōḏ miṣ·ra·yim tə·qab·bə·ṣêm mōp̄ tə·qab·bə·rêm maḥ·maḏ lə·ḵas·pām yî·rā·šêm qim·mō·wś ḥō·w·aḥ bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem
verses.literal: For even if they flee destruction Egypt will gather them and Memphis will bury them Their precious silver will be taken over by thistles [and] thorns [will overrun] their tents

verses.original: יְמֵ֣י הַפְּקֻדָּ֗ה בָּ֣אוּ׀ יְמֵ֣י הַשִׁלֻּ֔ם בָּ֚אוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵדְע֖וּ הַנָּבִ֗יא אֱוִ֣יל הָר֔וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ מְשֻׁגָּע֙ עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנְךָ֔ וְרַבָּ֖ה מַשְׂטֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yə·mê hap·pə·qud·dāh bā·’ū yə·mê ha·šil·lum bā·’ū yiś·rā·’êl yê·ḏə·‘ū han·nā·ḇî ’ĕ·wîl hā·rū·aḥ ’îš mə·šug·gā‘ ‘al rōḇ ‘ă·wō·nə·ḵā wə·rab·bāh maś·ṭê·māh
verses.literal: The days of punishment have come the days of retribution have arrived let Israel know it The prophet is [called] a fool and the inspired man insane because of the greatness of your iniquity . . . and hostility

verses.original: נָבִ֞יא אֶפְרַ֖יִם צֹפֶ֥ה עִם־ אֱלֹהָ֑י פַּ֤ח יָקוֹשׁ֙ עַל־ כָּל־ דְּרָכָ֔יו מַשְׂטֵמָ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇî ’ep̄·ra·yim ṣō·p̄eh ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·hāy paḥ yā·qō·wōš ‘al- kāl- də·rā·ḵāw maś·ṭê·māh bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman along with my God [yet] the snare of the fowler [lies] on all his paths Hostility is in the house of his God

verses.original: הֶעְמִֽיקוּ־ שִׁחֵ֖תוּ כִּימֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֑ה יִזְכּ֣וֹר עֲוֺנָ֔ם יִפְק֖וֹד חַטֹּאותָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: he‘·mî·qū- ši·ḥê·ṯū kî·mê hag·giḇ·‘āh yiz·kō·wr ‘ă·wō·nām yip̄·qō·wḏ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah He will remember their guilt He will punish their sins

verses.original: מָצָ֙אתִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּעֲנָבִ֣ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כְּבִכּוּרָ֤ה בִתְאֵנָה֙ בְּרֵ֣אשִׁיתָ֔הּ הֵ֜מָּה בָּ֣אוּ בַֽעַל־ פְּע֗וֹר וַיִּנָּֽזְרוּ֙ לַבֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיִּהְי֥וּ שִׁקּוּצִ֖ים כְּאָהֳבָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ṣā·ṯî yiś·rā·’êl ka·‘ă·nā·ḇîm bam·miḏ·bār rā·’î·ṯî ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem kə·ḇik·kū·rāh ḇiṯ·’ê·nāh bə·rê·šî·ṯāh hêm·māh bā·’ū ḇa·‘al- pə·‘ō·wr way·yin·nā·zə·rū lab·bō·šeṯ way·yih·yū šiq·qū·ṣîm kə·’ā·ho·ḇām
verses.literal: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness I saw your fathers as the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season But they went vvv to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to Shame so they became as detestable as the thing they loved

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם כְּבוֹדָ֑ם יִתְעוֹפֵ֣ף כָּע֖וֹף מִלֵּדָ֥ה וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן וּמֵהֵרָיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim kə·ḇō·w·ḏām yiṯ·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄ kā·‘ō·wp̄ mil·lê·ḏāh ū·mib·be·ṭen ū·mê·hê·rā·yō·wn
verses.literal: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird with no birth no pregnancy and no conception

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־ יְגַדְּלוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְשִׁכַּלְתִּ֖ים מֵֽאָדָ֑ם כִּֽי־ גַם־ א֥וֹי לָהֶ֖ם בְּשׂוּרִ֥י מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yə·ḡad·də·lū ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wə·šik·kal·tîm mê·’ā·ḏām kî- ḡam- ’ō·w lā·hem bə·śū·rî mê·hem
verses.literal: Even if they raise - their children I will bereave them of each one Yes . . . woe [be] to them when I turn away from them

verses.original: רָאִ֥יתִי אֶפְרַ֛יִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־ לְצ֖וֹר שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בְנָוֶ֑ה וְאֶפְרַ֕יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא בָּנָֽיו׃ אֶל־ הֹרֵ֖ג
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’ep̄·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer- lə·ṣō·wr šə·ṯū·lāh ḇə·nā·weh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim lə·hō·w·ṣî bā·nāw ’el- hō·rêḡ
verses.literal: I have seen Ephraim like Tyre planted in a meadow But Ephraim will bring out his children for slaughter

verses.original: תֵּן־ לָהֶ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מַה־ תִּתֵּ֑ן תֵּן־ לָהֶם֙ רֶ֣חֶם מַשְׁכִּ֔יל וְשָׁדַ֖יִם צֹמְקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: tên- lā·hem Yah·weh mah- tit·tên tên- lā·hem re·ḥem maš·kîl wə·šā·ḏa·yim ṣō·mə·qîm
verses.literal: Give them O LORD what will You give Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that dry up

verses.original: כָּל־ רָעָתָ֤ם בַּגִּלְגָּל֙ כִּֽי־ שָׁ֣ם שְׂנֵאתִ֔ים אֲגָרְשֵׁ֑ם מִבֵּיתִ֖י עַ֚ל רֹ֣עַ מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֤א אוֹסֵף֙ אַהֲבָתָ֔ם כָּל־ שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם סֹרְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām bag·gil·gāl kî- šām śə·nê·ṯîm ’ă·ḡā·rə·šêm mib·bê·ṯî ‘al rō·a‘ ma·‘al·lê·hem lō ’ō·w·sêp̄ ’a·hă·ḇā·ṯām kāl- śā·rê·hem sō·rə·rîm
verses.literal: All their evil appears at Gilgal for there I hated them I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds I will no longer love them all their leaders are rebellious

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֔יִם הֻכָּ֣ה שָׁרְשָׁ֥ם יָבֵ֖שׁ יַעֲשׂ֑וּן פְּרִ֣י בְלִי גַּ֚ם כִּ֣י יֵֽלֵד֔וּן וְהֵמַתִּ֖י מַחֲמַדֵּ֥י בִטְנָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim huk·kāh šā·rə·šām yā·ḇêš ya·‘ă·śūn pə·rî ḇə·lī gam kî yê·lê·ḏūn wə·hê·mat·tî ma·ḥă·mad·dê ḇiṭ·nām
verses.literal: Ephraim is struck down their root is withered they cannot bear fruit . . . Even if they bear children I will slay the darlings of their wombs

verses.original: אֱלֹהַ֔י יִמְאָסֵ֣ם כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ל֑וֹ וְיִהְי֥וּ נֹדְדִ֖ים בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hay yim·’ā·sêm kî lō šā·mə·‘ū lōw wə·yih·yū nō·ḏə·ḏîm bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed Him and they shall be wanderers among the nations
